verdict.rationale: Linear's customer-requests docs cover linking, viewing and filtering customer asks, and syncing them from Slack and Intercom. None of the evidence shows customers being notified automatically when a requested issue's status changes. The GraphQL API and agent platform are only developer building blocks someone could use to build such notifications, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically notify customers when the status of their requested feature changes
